'''Nova 13''' was a [[Disease/Legends|disease]] that was known by the time of the [[Galactic War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]]. A sample of one strain of the disease was stored in the vaults on board the Imperial treasure ship [[King's Ransom (treasury ship)|''King's Ransom'']] during the war. It was stolen, along with various other valuable objects, by a [[Voidhound|smuggler]] working as a Republic [[Privateer/Legends|privateer]].
